# IndiumVault

> IndiumVault is an independent digital studio with free browser-based utilities. The site is hosted on GitHub Pages.

## Main pages
- Home: https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/
- Free online tools: https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/tools.html
- How-to guides: https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/guides.html
- Privacy policy: https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/privacy.html
- Terms of use: https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/terms.html

## Free browser tools
- Word and character counter: https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/word-counter.html
- Text case converter: https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/text-case-converter.html
- JSON formatter: https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/json-formatter.html
- Password generator: https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/password-generator.html
- UUID v4 generator: https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/uuid-generator.html
- Unit converter: https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/unit-converter.html

## Notes
- The tools are intended to run in the browser; consult each page and the privacy policy for details.
- The site does not currently offer an API or require an account for the listed tools.
- Public repository: https://github.com/indiumvault/Indiumvalut-website
